summary: Connected runners now sync and verify the signed per-environment control (kill switch, budget ceiling, rate limit) and expose it as glirastes.control(). Turns do not enforce it yet.
howTo: Nothing to do. The runner sends controlVersion=1 on sync and reports capabilities.environmentControl: 1; an older Platform answers as before. A control that fails its schema or signature, names another scope, or changes without a new sequence halts the runner locally with control_unverifiable and reaches onError as RuntimeEnvironmentControlError. createGlirastes keeps the control in memory only: after a restart the halt applies again after the first sync. A RuntimeSyncManager you construct yourself takes optional targetAppId and onControlRejected; a verifier you pass must implement verifyEnvironmentControl. State files written by older versions load unchanged.
